gaps: Doc-type classification is by title/URL keywords (no structured type field exists on the portal); classification quality is heuristic. Attachment census (53/737 articles file-bearing) confirms most articles are text-only.

4 of 53 file-bearing articles (e.g., AVer-PTZapp-for-Mac/Windows) return 204 no-body on fileField — their links point to external downloaders/App stores; downloads for those resolve as text/links, not PDFs.

novel_features.name: Model spec comparison
novel_features.description: Side-by-side spec fields for two or more AVer models from their datasheets, ready for bid comparisons and RFP tables. Spec fields come from datasheet PDFs extracted by `harvest --with-specs`.
novel_features.rationale: Spec values exist only inside per-model datasheet PDFs; only a local synced spec_fields table can render a cross-model matrix.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this instead of opening N datasheet PDFs to answer 'which model fits?' for a bid.

novel_features.name: Single-model spec dump
novel_features.description: One model's full spec fields as clean text or JSON for spec-compliance tables and agent pipelines. Fields come from datasheet PDFs extracted by `harvest --with-specs`.
novel_features.rationale: Requires sync-time extraction of fields from the model's datasheet PDF into the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to fill an RFP spec-compliance row without opening the PDF.

novel_features.name: Doc link audit
novel_features.description: HEAD-checks every document URL in the catalog and flags 404s and soft-404 shells, caching last-checked status locally.
novel_features.rationale: Only a synced catalog can audit the whole link set at once; averusa.com serves 200 soft-404 shells for guessed paths and even mislinks datasheets on product pages.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before pushing docs to a shared drive to catch dead or mislinked PDFs while they are still cheap to fix.

novel_features.name: Offline job bag
novel_features.description: Batch-download every document for a model into one offline folder with stable <model>-<type> names, with a --dry-run preview. Downloads need entityIds, which `harvest` resolves at sync time.
novel_features.rationale: Groups the synced documents table by model and neutralizes the portal's unstructured PDF filenames with deterministic naming.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to pre-stage a job bag of manuals before driving to a site with no signal.

novel_features.name: What's-new diff
novel_features.description: List documents and products added or updated since the last sync, filterable by age.
novel_features.rationale: No changelog exists on averusa.com; only the local sync-state cursor diff can answer 'what changed since I last looked'.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to track new manuals or firmware docs across a fleet without re-checking the website.

novel_features.name: Doc coverage matrix
novel_features.description: Per-model doc-type availability matrix for a category, flagging which models are missing manuals, spec sheets, or white papers.
novel_features.rationale: A pure local LEFT JOIN of products and documents pivoted on the doc-type enum — no site page shows coverage.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before a recommendation or commissioning checklist to catch missing compliance docs.

novel_features.name: Current vs discontinued
novel_features.description: Flag which models AVer lists as discontinued, filterable by category.
novel_features.rationale: Current/discontinued status is unstructured HTML text on the /support/ page; only sync-time parsing into a local products.discontinued flag makes it queryable.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before specing a model into a school bid so a discontinued unit never ships in the quote.

narrative.headline: Every AVer USA manual, spec sheet, and white paper in a local, type-filtered catalog — with spec comparison and link audits no AVer site offers.
narrative.value_prop: averusa.com hides its manuals, spec sheets, and white papers behind a Salesforce portal maze and per-model PDFs. averusa-pp-cli syncs the whole catalog into a local database, then answers the questions integrators actually ask: which model fits (compare), what are its specs (specs), what docs exist per model (coverage, docs pack), what changed since last sync (whats-new), and which PDF links are dead (doctor).

quickstart.comment: Health check that works with no credentials — confirms the CLI and its config are sane.
Build the local corpus from the support portal and product catalog — everything else reads it.
Type-filtered search over the synced catalog, offline.
Grab the whole offline doc bag for a model before heading to the jobsite.
Side-by-side specs from the datasheets for a bid comparison.

troubleshoots.symptom: docs search returns nothing right after install
troubleshoots.fix: Run `averusa-pp-cli harvest` first — search reads the local corpus, which starts empty.

troubleshoots.symptom: docs download fails for an article with no known entityId
troubleshoots.fix: fileField downloads need a Salesforce entityId, which `harvest` now resolves for all 737 articles; articles without an attached file (the majority) return no-body 204, and `docs audit` reports which URLs are unverifiable.

troubleshoots.symptom: a PDF link returns a 200 HTML shell instead of a PDF
troubleshoots.fix: averusa.com serves 61301-byte soft-404 shells for guessed paths. Run `averusa-pp-cli docs audit` to audit link health, then re-sync.

narrative.when_to_use: Use averusa-pp-cli whenever an agent or integrator needs an AVer USA user manual, spec sheet/datasheet, or white paper — browsing the type-filtered catalog, comparing models for a bid, assembling an offline job bag, or auditing which PDF links are still alive. Its local store answers cross-document questions ('which model has a white paper and which is discontinued?') that the Salesforce portal cannot.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to control AVer PTZ or conference cameras — that is device control over VISCA/IP, which belongs to Bitfocus Companion or vendor device tools.
Do not use it to download or install firmware — the portal indexes firmware articles, but binary download entityIds are not fully seeded and firmware installation is a device operation.
